definitions.explanation: Reserved for a particular person, purpose, or function. Used as a no-adjective to modify nouns: {専用|せんよう}の~ (dedicated ~).

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}{専用|せんよう}の{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}がある。
examples.english: There is a parking space reserved for the company president.

examples.japanese: このアプリは{会員|かいいん}{専用|せんよう}です。
examples.english: This app is for members only.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}{専用|せんよう}{車両|しゃりょう}は{朝|あさ}の{通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ{時|じ}に{設|もう}けられている。
examples.english: Women-only train cars are provided during the morning commute rush.

notes:
USAGE:
{専用|せんよう} is extremely common in daily life, appearing on signs, labels, and in instructions. It functions primarily as a no-adjective or prefix: {専用|せんよう}の～ or ～{専用|せんよう} (dedicated to ~). It can also be used as a する verb meaning "to use exclusively."

PATTERNS:
- ～{専用|せんよう}: dedicated to ~, exclusively for ~ (e.g., {子|こ}ども{専用|せんよう} — for children only)
- {専用|せんよう}の～: dedicated ~ (e.g., {専用|せんよう}の{道具|どうぐ} — dedicated tools)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女性|じょせい}{専用|せんよう}: women-only
- {会員|かいいん}{専用|せんよう}: members-only
- {専用|せんよう}{機|き}: dedicated device/aircraft
- {専用|せんよう}{線|せん}: dedicated line
- {専用|せんよう}アプリ: dedicated app
